effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] If [Magnadramon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, all of your opponent's Digimon and Security Digimon get -1000 DP for the turn for each card in your security stack.
[End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] You may add the top card of your security stack to your hand to unsuspend this Digimon.
